lede: The biggest thing happening at the government level this week is Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code goes to its third and final reading — pass it and the Land Use Code changes in ways that affect what every property owner here can do with landscaping and historic structures. Ridgway's council also has a full plate Wednesday, with a public hearing on a subdivision and a joint work session on a new Housing Action Plan. Meanwhile, the Mushroom Festival rolls into town mid-week and the Ridgway Rendezvous fills the weekend.
